review_evidence: README describes an implementation of the Spark API for Lean whose goal is to reject malformed dataframe queries at compile time and eventually communicate with Spark via FFI.
A complete scan of all four Lean files found only eight declaration-style lines and no theorem, lemma, axiom, or proposition-example declarations.

The substantive Spark/Spark.lean file is a short prototype defining Column/Scheme/DataFrame, Boolean schema checks and an unfinished DataFrame.select ending in sorry; it does not define or prove a Spark query semantics, conformance result, or reusable correctness development.
